items.claim: CEO confirms record backlog reported at end of Q3.
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO

items.claim: CEO says all indications point to Q4 ending with another record backlog.
items.quote: that we should end up with another record
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO

items.claim: CEO states current-year revenue growth is 14%, framed as a combined growth+margin "rule of 58%".
items.quote: revenue growth is 14%, okay? So that's a rule of 58%.
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO

items.claim: CEO says the company has raised margin every year for the past 5-10 years and expects to keep doing so.
items.quote: increased margin every year for the last 5, 10 years
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO

items.claim: CEO flags that 2026 incremental margin may run lower before accelerating in 2027.
items.quote: in '26. Our incremental margin is a little lower, but '27
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO

items.claim: CEO states the company continues to target 50%+ incremental margin.
items.quote: we are always shooting for 50% plus incremental margin.
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO

items.claim: CEO states the buyback is sized to ensure no net dilution from stock-based comp.
items.quote: we want to make sure that there is no dilution
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO

items.claim: CEO reiterates the company returns 50% of cash flow to buy back stock.
items.quote: We will take 50% of our cash flow and we buy back our stock
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO

items.claim: CEO says remaining cash may go to opportunistic M&A but the financial model is unchanged.
items.quote: it does not change our model, which we have done
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO

items.claim: CEO responds to the Synopsys-Ansys deal by saying Cadence already competes with them separately.
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO

items.claim: CEO says the system business has grown roughly 25% a year for the last 5-6 years, pointing to the silicon-system merger thesis he pursued since 2018.
items.quote: our system business has grown like, I don't know, 25% a year
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO

items.claim: CEO says applying AI to Cadence's own products can deliver at least 10x productivity improvement.
items.quote: there's at least 10x productivity improvement we can deliver
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO

items.claim: CEO describes the Palladium hardware-software emulation systems as core to modern chip design.
items.quote: Palladium and these hardware systems became basically
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO

items.claim: CEO says the emulator verifies chip designs roughly 1,000x faster than regular silicon.
items.quote: it will verify the design like 1,000x faster
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO

items.claim: CEO says IP segment is performing well across all reported areas.
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO

items.claim: CEO says roughly 45% of business now comes from system companies rather than traditional semiconductor customers.
items.quote: business is coming from system companies
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO

items.claim: CEO says China's share of EDA/software business has declined from about 16-17% a few years ago to about 11-12% now.
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO

items.claim: CEO says some China business shifted from Q2 to Q3 this year due to restrictions, now resolved.
items.quote: some of our business moved from Q2
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO

items.claim: CEO says geopolitical conditions are hard to predict but currently look stable for China design activity.
items.quote: geopolitical, but seems stable for now
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO
